Read More We changed the way energy is imported when we established floating storage and regasification units (FSRUs) as a commercially viable solution to access LNG across the globe. Today, we not only own and operate one of the largest floating LNG terminal portfolios in the industry, but we also have the proven experience to ensure the safe and reliable delivery of natural gas to meet any demand. As the global leader in floating LNG terminals and downstream LNG infrastructure, our projects are backed by unrivaled industry experience in developing and operating complex LNG solutions. Our floating LNG terminals act, in all aspects, similar to land-based import terminals. In addition to transporting LNG, our purpose-built FSRUs have the onboard capability to vaporize LNG and deliver natural gas through specially designed offshore and near-shore receiving facilities. Our floating LNG terminals can deliver regasified LNG at pipeline pressure with flow rates ranging from 690 MMscf/d to more than 1,200 MMscf/d continuously, providing quick and convenient access to incremental gas supplies. FSRU Benefits An integrated and flexible LNG import solution tailored to fit almost any environment. Cost Effective In most cases, a floating regasification solution is more cost-effective per MMbtu than a traditional land-based solution. Time Efficient A floating solution can be implemented in one to three years versus a land-based terminal, which typically takes four to six years to develop. Minimal Footprint A dockside or offshore regasification facility requires less land use than a land-based terminal, minimizing environmental impacts. Cleaner Solution Floating LNG terminals allow countries to transition away from coal and liquid fuels, while bridging the gap to cleaner energy. Our floating LNG terminals allow for conventional LNG loading with discharge: as a liquid at a conventional receiving terminal, as gas through a high-pressure gas manifold, or as gas through a subsea buoy system. They are permanently moored to a docking facility at a location close to a market access point. Depending on the geographic location and environmental conditions, the mooring infrastructure is tailored to fit specific environmental requirements. Geography and ocean conditions largely dictate which solution is the right choice for the project, but we are able to operate in even the most challenging conditions. FSRU 101 Floating Regasification FSRUs have the onboard capability to vaporize LNG and deliver natural gas via specially designed receiving facilities. Our FSRUs are flexible, allowing for conventional LNG loading with discharge: as a liquid at a conventional receiving terminal, as gas through a high-pressure gas manifold, or as gas through a subsea buoy system. Marine Infrastructure Our FSRUs are permanently moored to a docking facility at a location close to a market access point. Depending on the geographic location and environmental conditions, the mooring infrastructure is tailored to fit specific environmental requirements. Geography and ocean conditions largely dictate which solution is the right choice for the project, but we are able to operate in even the most challenging conditions. Gas Delivery We have a range of fully engineered mooring solutions that can be readily tailored to specific opportunities, reducing the time required for front-end engineering design. Our FSRUs are engineered to connect to an existing natural gas distribution network and discharge high-pressure natural gas to shore via pipeline. For dockside application, natural gas is discharged via high-pressure gas offloading arm mounted to a jetty infrastructure. For offshore application, natural gas is discharged through a subsea buoy linked to a subsea pipeline. The vessel is being designed and built by HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, the world’s largest shipbuilder and a leading builder of FSRUs. Engineering and design are being finalized and construction is due to begin in the second half of 2023, with delivery expected in June 2026, after thorough testing and trials. Ship Management – ETM Excelerate Technical Management (ETM) is our wholly-owned subsidiary responsible for the management of ship operations and the welfare and well-being of our professional seafarers. With ETM’s holistic approach and complete management structure of both the vessels and personnel on board, customers benefit from our deep expertise, operational efficiencies, transparent approach, and dependability of industry-leading processes and reliable management systems. ETM is also responsible for the operations and maintenance of Excelerate’s fleet of FSRUs. Our dedicated personnel seeks continual education and certifications, accruing valuable training and credentials to ensure that they are effectively and safely executing for our customers in any environment. Additionally, our personnel is skilled in managing the fixed infrastructure and interfaces required to moor, connect and operate the FSRU within your distribution network.
